name: Stéphane Hallegatte
notes: No personal site/CV; built from his self-registered RePEc/IDEAS page (journal articles 2007-2026, a chapter, and unpublished World Bank PRWPs/CESifo/IMF/PIIE working papers 2019-2026). The IDEAS page is very long and was read through an extraction: output is a substantial but NOT exhaustive subset - items whose IDEAS author lists are truncated (e.g. 'Hanson et al.', 'Ranger et al.', 'Erman et al.', 'Peng et al.', 'Mapping the climate change challenge') were left out, as were commentaries/editorials (Noy-Managi-Hallegatte editorials, Nature 'Make climate-change assessments more relevant', etc.), books, and pre-2019 PRWPs. Where IDEAS shows only a surname for a coauthor, the surname is entered as-is (several names are surnames only). 'From Poverty to Disaster and Back' and 'Future flood losses', 'Quantification of disaster impacts' bylines are from memory of the published papers and not verified against the page; treat as lower-confidence. WPs later published as articles were dropped by title match (e.g. PRWP 9943, 10014, 10318, 10486, 10971, Monash 2025-08 version of the NCC 2026 paper). PIIE WP24-6 is the later version of PRWP 10367.
